title: MolReps: Taking SELFIES, Making SMILES, Teaching LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.20848v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The same molecule can be expressed in multiple, syntactically distinct representations, yet it remains unclear whether large language models (LLMs) can recognize and relate these equivalent encodings. We introduce MolReps, a pipeline that generates 9,600 question-answer pairs across ten representations for conversion, normalization, and 2D structure recognition. Post-training on MolReps improves text-only and multimodal models, MolQwen3-4B-Instruct (MQ3-4B-I) and MolQwen3-VL-4B-Instruct (MQ3-VL-4B-I), from $4.01\%$ to $75.13\%$ and from $7.11\%$ to $73.14\%$ (InChIKey match) on the molecule-overlap test set, respectively. On the molecule-disjoint test set, post-training increased validity from $20.35\%$ to $58.12\%$ for MQ3-4B-I and from $17.19\%$ to $59.34\%$ for MQ3-VL-4B-I. translated_title: MolReps：转换SELFIES，生成SMILES，训练大语言模型
translated_abstract: 同一个分子可以用多种语法上不同的表示形式来表达，然而大语言模型（LLM）能否识别并关联这些等价的编码方式仍不清楚。我们提出了MolReps，这是一个可生成9,600个问答对的数据流水线，涵盖十种分子表示形式，用于表示转换、规范化以及二维结构识别任务。在MolReps上进行后训练后，纯文本模型MolQwen3-4B-Instruct（MQ3-4B-I）和多模态模型MolQwen3-VL-4B-Instruct（MQ3-VL-4B-I）在分子重叠测试集上的InChIKey匹配率分别从4.01%提升至75.13%和从7.11%提升至73.14%。在分子不重叠测试集上，后训练使MQ3-4B-I的有效性从20.35%提升至58.12%，MQ3-VL-4B-I的有效性从17.19%提升至59.34%。然而，InChIKey匹配率仍然较低，分别从3.86%降至3.09%和从6.44%降至2.29%。此外，所得模型实现了……
tldr: 提出MolReps数据集（9,600个问答对，覆盖十种分子表示形式），通过后训练大幅提升大语言模型在分子表示转换与识别任务上的能力（如InChIKey匹配率从约4%提升至75%），但对未见分子的泛化能力仍然有限。
en_tdlr: The authors introduce MolReps, a dataset of 9,600 QA pairs spanning ten molecular representations, whose post-training dramatically improves LLMs' ability to interconvert and recognize equivalent molecular encodings (e.g., InChIKey match rising from ~4% to ~75%), though generalization to unseen molecules remains limited.
